evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: The official draft-zambo-aer1-26 conformance vectors, blinded rater annotations, and live MCP wire-state ground truth provide evaluator-independent measurements that corroborate the reported gains.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Headline outcomes are established by deterministic protocol conformance suites, the official AER-1 test kit, fault-injected wire traces, and frozen or zero-shot post-release benchmark cohorts evaluated against ground-truth wire states.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: The system's neural components are pre-trained or fine-tuned OpenVINO INT8 encoders, and its symbolic rules were hardened across v0.3.0 to v0.5.2 iterations against earlier benchmark cohorts.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims regarding deterministic tamper rejection, execution state classification, CPU efficiency (0MiB VRAM, 9-18ms median latency), and empirical accuracy advantages over 12B-14B LLM judges are supported by explicit test metrics and statistical significance testing.
primary.evaluation_assessment: The evaluation combines formal protocol conformance/fault-injection tests (200 Merkle leaves, 58 AER-1 vectors, 40 wire calls, 100 concurrent appends) with comparative empirical benchmarks against GPU LLM judges and NLI baselines across frozen (N=250) and live (N=60) traces, demonstrating solid latency and accuracy improvements.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Evaluation relies on external protocol conformance test vectors (draft-zambo-aer1-26), blinded rater annotations, and live tool execution traces evaluated against ground-truth wire states.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Deterministic protocol conformance suites (official AER-1 test kit, fault injections), an audited frozen benchmark cohort (N=250), and zero-shot post-release live MCP traces (N=60).
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Pre-trained and fine-tuned OpenVINO INT8 weights along with frozen heuristic/symbolic rule definitions hardened against earlier design iterations.

primary.limitations: The authors clearly outline limitations, including the restriction to stdio MCP transports, reliance on downstream servers not faking ok=true payloads, degradation of deduplication on heavy/abstractive rewrites, and elevated false positive rates on custom unmapped tool stems.
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is thoroughly detailed, describing out-of-process Ed25519 signing key isolation, RFC6962 Merkle logging with bidirectional AER-1 receipt translation, a two-stage symbolic-neural supervisor using an INT8 OpenVINO encoder, and SQLite provenance-gated storage.
primary.quality_rationale: The work presents an adequately scoped, well-architected systems and runtime verification contribution with extensive reproducible conformance and empirical evaluation.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces epistemic-guard (v0.5.2), a lightweight CPU-based runtime verification library and out-of-process stdio MCP proxy designed to guard autonomous agents against action fabrication, provenance collapse, and syndicated echo amplification.
